_readme: CleverCoder community skills catalog. Each entry describes a skill that can be installed into a project to extend what Claude Code can do. This file is fetched by CleverCoder at runtime from its `_source` URL; the local copy in %APPDATA%/CleverCoder/skills_catalog.json acts as an offline cache. Pull requests with new skills or corrections are welcome at https://github.com/chamilonster/clevercoder-skills-catalog.

_schema.Id: Unique identifier, lowercase with dashes. Used as the folder name when cloning (.claude/skills/<Id>/). Do not change on existing entries — it would break install-detection.
_schema.Name: Display name shown in the UI. Emojis allowed.
_schema.Description: Full English description. Use \n for line breaks. Ideally explains WHAT it does, WHEN to use it, and which commands it enables.
_schema.Category: Grouping label for the catalog window. Used values: Productivity, Development, Security, Organization, Content, Notifications.
_schema.Emoji: Representative emoji shown next to the name in the list.
_schema.GitHubUrl: GitHub repo URL. Used for opening in browser and for fetching stars via the GitHub API.
_schema.Author: Author or GitHub username. When empty or 'community', CleverCoder extracts it from GitHubUrl.
_schema.Method: Install method. Valid values: GitClone, NpxRun, OpenUrl, PluginInstall, PipInstall.
_schema.InstallCommand: Explicit install command overriding the one derived from Method. For GitClone: `git clone <url>` — CleverCoder appends the destination. For NpxRun/PipInstall: the full command.
_schema.Commands: List of Claude Code commands this skill enables (without the leading /). Source of truth for the Use button in the terminal. If empty, CleverCoder scans .claude/skills/<Id>/commands/ in the installed repo.
_schema._source: Optional remote catalog URL (JSON). When set, CleverCoder downloads the skills from this URL when the catalog opens and replaces the local list. The local file then acts as an offline cache.
_schema._catalogVersion: Integer version of the hardcoded defaults the catalog was built from. CleverCoder compares this against its shipped CommunitySkillsCatalog.CatalogVersion on load — when the file is older, non-custom entries are reconciled from the app's defaults while user-authored 'custom' entries are preserved.

skills.Name: Anthropic Document Skills
skills.Description:
Official Anthropic plugin pack for document handling: docx, pdf, pptx, xlsx. Create, edit and analyze Word/PDF/PowerPoint/Excel files with full fidelity.

Install via Claude Code's official plugin marketplace:
  /plugin marketplace add anthropics/skills
  /plugin install document-skills@anthropic-agent-skills
skills.Author: anthropics

skills.Name: Anthropic Example Skills
skills.Description:
Official Anthropic plugin pack with creative + development examples: algorithmic-art, canvas-design, slack-gif-creator, brand-guidelines, mcp-builder, web-artifacts-builder, webapp-testing, skill-creator, frontend-design, internal-comms.

Install via Claude Code's official plugin marketplace:
  /plugin marketplace add anthropics/skills
  /plugin install example-skills@anthropic-agent-skills
skills.Author: anthropics

skills.Name: Caveman (original) 🦴
skills.Description:
Why use many token when few token do trick. Cuts ~65% of Claude's output tokens by making it talk in caveman style: short sentences, no filler, no apology, no preamble. Top-tier popularity in the Claude Code ecosystem.

Use when you want shorter answers, lower bills, or faster reads.
skills.Author: JuliusBrussee

skills.Name: Expo Skills
skills.Description:
Official skills from the Expo team for building React Native + Expo apps. Includes guidance on routing, navigation, Expo SDK modules, app deployment via EAS, and mobile-specific best practices.

Use when working on Expo / React Native projects.
skills.Author: expo

skills.Name: Caveman (ultra) 💎
skills.Description: Ultra-compressed AI output mode — variant of caveman optimized for further token reduction. Distill text to its core meaning. Use after caveman if you need even tighter output, or instead of it for write-heavy tasks (summaries, status reports).
skills.Author: dlepold

skills.Name: shadcn/ui
skills.Description:
Provides context about shadcn components and applies the design patterns to your project's UI. Use when building React UIs with shadcn-style components.

Reference docs at https://ui.shadcn.com/docs/skills
skills.Author: shadcn

skills.Name: Web Asset Generator
skills.Description: Generate web assets from your source artwork: favicons (multiple sizes + ICO), app icons (iOS/Android), Open Graph images, PWA manifests, and social media images. Useful for every web project that needs polished branding assets.
skills.Author: alonw0

skills.Name: Playwright Browser Automation
skills.Description: General browser automation using Playwright. Click, fill forms, screenshot, scrape and verify any web page or app. Useful for E2E testing local apps, scraping data, automating manual workflows, or driving a browser from natural-language instructions.
skills.Author: lackeyjb

skills.Name: Trail of Bits Security Skills
skills.Description:
Security skills by Trail of Bits — a recognized authority in vulnerability research and security audit. Static analysis, code auditing, vulnerability detection patterns adapted for Claude Code review tasks.

Use when running security reviews on code, dependencies, or infrastructure.
skills.Author: trailofbits

skills.Name: Claude Scientific Skills
skills.Description:
Comprehensive collection of scientific skills for Claude Code: bioinformatics, statistics, ML pipelines, scientific computing, with specialized libraries and database integrations.

Use on academic / research projects or data-heavy analytical work.
skills.Author: K-Dense-AI

skills.Name: Auto Skills
skills.Description:
Automatically detects your project's stack (React, Next.js, Vue, Astro, TypeScript, Tailwind, Python, and 20+ more) and installs the most useful skills for it — no manual setup.

Run one command at your project root and autoskills inspects config files (package.json, requirements.txt, etc.) to pick and install the relevant skills.

Usage:
  npx autoskills

No global install required. Works with Claude Code and other AI agents that support the skills format.
skills.Author: midudev
